scientific_integrity: Proof and finite checks are separately described; finite tests do not prove the infinite-family geometry. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Reduced tuple varieties of the six-dimensional strictly upper triangular four-by-four Lie algebra; no claim about commuting schemes, larger matrices, or independent mathematical validation. Basili (2016) was assessed only from an abstract.
title: Three rational components of higher commuting-tuple varieties in the four-by-four nilradical
